_comment: The ZFS tools and smartmontools, hosted by a device's agent. No distribution but Ubuntu ships ZFS in its default repositories, so each family's pre_install steps add the repository the distribution keeps it in and build the kernel module where none is shipped. zfs-zed is spelled out on Debian: it is only a Recommends of zfsutils-linux.
name: zfs
title: ZFS storage
description: Pooled storage with redundancy and compression

pre_install: for f in /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.list; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; sed -i -E '/^deb(-src)? .*debian\.org/{/ contrib/! s/$/ contrib/}' "$f"; done
for f in /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; grep -qE 'debian\.org|mirror\+file' "$f" || continue; sed -i -E '/^Components:/{/contrib/! s/$/ contrib/}' "$f"; done
